clue.text: Quickly prepare large drink on time

indicators.note: in an across clue, putting one piece on another means it follows it, so the time letter comes first

parts.note: T is the standard abbreviation for time
OS stands for outsize, a clothing label for large
to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: Someone is told to fix a big drink in a hurry before they are due somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The large drink is two pieces, outsize then sup, and 'on time' places them after the time letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To toss up a meal is an informal idiom for throwing it together hastily, as you would cook something fast.

clue.text: Revealing breasts reduced following last of implant surgery

indicators.note: following says the word for reduced comes after the other pieces
last of asks for only the final letter of the following word

parts.note: the final letter of implant
an op is an operation, i.e. surgery
something reduced is less than before

explanation.surface: A woman shows off her chest, now smaller after having an implant removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A topless woman has her bare chest on show, so the adjective describes someone exposing her bosom.

clue.text: Model entering beach to show stomach

indicators.note: entering means one piece goes into the middle of the other

parts.note: a beach is made of sand
the Model T was Ford's famous car, so Model gives T

explanation.surface: A fashion model walks onto the beach to flaunt her flat belly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stomach' looks like a noun for a body part; here it is the verb meaning put up with.
explanation.definitionFit: To stomach something is to tolerate it, and to stand it means exactly the same.

clue.text: IT handles customer calls

parts.note: a user of a service is its customer
to call someone something is to name them

explanation.surface: An IT helpdesk deals with phone calls from customers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Handles' looks like a verb about dealing with calls, but IT handles are the names you log in with.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing, a handle is the identifier a person uses online or on a system, i.e. a login name.

clue.text: One sees couple at the back inside pictures

parts.note: the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: inside says that letter goes within the word for sees

parts.note: someone who sees a partner romantically dates them

indicators.note: at the back asks for only the final letter of the word before it

parts.note: the final letter of couple

explanation.surface: A man spots a pair at the rear of a cinema showing films.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One sees' looks like a unit and the definition; it is two pieces, and the definition sits at the end as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To ideate is to form an idea of something in the mind, which is to imagine or picture it.

clue.text: Off sick, not available

indicators.note: something gone off is spoiled or out of order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: An employee is away ill and cannot be reached.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface says unavailable; the answer means the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods in stock are held by the shop and so ready to be bought.

clue.text: Went out of section of dartboard after treble in the middle

indicators.note: after places the dartboard section behind the central letters
in the middle asks for only the central letters of the word before it

parts.note: the central two letters of treble
the doubles and trebles rings of a dartboard are called beds

explanation.surface: A darts player's throw left the scoring area after landing in the treble ring.
explanation.walkthrough: In darts each scoring segment is a bed: a double bed, a treble bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The tide ebbs when it goes out, so ebbed is the past tense of retreating like the sea.

clue.text: One might get food by filling hot jacket potato, finally ordered selection

definitions.text: One might get food by filling

indicators.note: ordered means put into a new arrangement, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: finally asks for only the last letters of the preceding words

parts.note: the final letters of jacket and potato
your pick is your selection

explanation.surface: Someone stuffs a hot baked potato and chooses its topping carefully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Filling' reads as what goes in a jacket potato; in the definition it is a dental filling where food gets stuck.
explanation.definitionFit: A toothpick is a thin stick used to dig out bits of food lodged between teeth, such as beside a filling.

clue.text: Son lost it: any reason?

indicators.note: letters that are lost have gone astray from their order, so they are rearranged

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A parent wonders why their boy lost his temper for no apparent cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reason' looks like a cause asked for; here it is the noun for soundness of mind, and losing it is the joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Reason in the sense of a sound mind, as in 'lost his reason', is sanity.

clue.text: Copy coach getting 10 regularly

parts.note: a railway coach is a car

indicators.note: regularly asks for letters at even intervals, here the first, third and fifth

parts.note: 10 points to the answer at 10 across, and its odd letters are taken

explanation.surface: A coach operator copies details down from another source.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference is to 10 across, BROWN, whose first, third and fifth letters are used.
explanation.definitionFit: A carbon is a carbon copy, the duplicate made with carbon paper.

clue.text: What might be on table is put with McDonald's food (no starter)

indicators.note: no starter means the first letter is dropped from the word for food

parts.note: to put something is to place it
the McDonald's golden arches logo is a big M
eats is slang for food

explanation.surface: Someone sets down a burger meal on the dining table, skipping the first course.
explanation.walkthrough: McDonald's stands for its famous golden-arches M.
explanation.definitionFit: Place mats are protective mats laid on a dining table under each diner's plate.

clue.text: Brazil has particular coffee?

definitions.note: an adjective for colour, as in a coffee-coloured coat

parts.note: BR is the international abbreviation for Brazil
your own is particular to you

explanation.surface: Brazil, famous for coffee, has its own special variety.
explanation.walkthrough: Coffee seems to be the drink Brazil grows; it is the light-brown colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffee as a colour is a medium shade of brown, the colour of milky coffee.

clue.text: Party of women out of hotel: number pointing at you?

indicators.note: out of says the hotel letter leaves the party phrase

parts.note: a hen do is a British party for a bride-to-be and her female friends
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
N is the abbreviation for number

explanation.surface: A rowdy hen party is thrown out of a hotel, with one room number pointing at you.
explanation.definitionFit: Something end-on faces you with its end, as a ship seen bow first is aimed at the viewer.

clue.text: Ruddy family photograph

parts.note: your blood is your family or kin
a shot is a photograph

explanation.surface: A grumble about an annoying family picture, ruddy used as a mild swear word.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ruddy' reads as the British mild curse; it is the definition, meaning reddened.
explanation.definitionFit: Bloodshot eyes are red and inflamed, and ruddy means reddish in colour.

clue.text: Maiden's going out with band member

indicators.note: letters going out leave their places, so they come back in a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A young woman is dating a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: A sideman is a supporting musician in a band or jazz group rather than its leader.

clue.text: Sure is one not adored at work

indicators.note: letters at work are busy being reshaped, so they are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is certain they are unloved by colleagues at the office.
explanation.walkthrough: Sure is a well-known British brand of antiperspirant, disguised as the adjective for certain.
explanation.definitionFit: Sure is a brand name of underarm spray, so it is an example of the product.

clue.text: Wind up? Peg out little one

parts.note: to wind someone up is to tease or kid them
to peg out is slang for to die

explanation.surface: Instructions to tighten a tent and pull its pegs up.
explanation.walkthrough: Wind up and peg out sound like camping or clockwork tasks; both are British slang verbs, tease and die.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiddie is an informal word for a young child, a little one.

clue.text: TV bore with rock group

parts.note: a drag is something tedious, a bore
Queen is the British rock band of Freddie Mercury

explanation.surface: Television is dull, except when rock bands appear.
explanation.walkthrough: TV looks like television; here it is the abbreviation for transvestite.
explanation.definitionFit: TV is short for transvestite, and a drag queen is a man performing in women's clothing.

clue.text: Dirt, so pig's rolling around

indicators.note: rolling around tumbles the letters into a different order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A pig is caked in mud because it has been wallowing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dirt' looks like mud; it is the slang sense, scandalous information about people.
explanation.definitionFit: To dish the dirt on someone is to spread scandal, so dirt is a synonym of rumour and tittle-tattle.

clue.text: Designer lotion ultimately collected by shaver

indicators.note: collected by means the letter is held within the word for shaver

parts.note: a planer is a tool that shaves wood

indicators.note: ultimately asks for only the final letter of the word before it

parts.note: the final letter of lotion

explanation.surface: A fashion designer's aftershave lotion is picked up by a razor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shaver' suggests a razor; it is the carpenter's tool that pares wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A planner is someone who draws up designs, as a town planner lays out a district.

clue.text: Live with mistress? Husband in bed excited

indicators.note: in places the husband letter inside the word for bed

parts.note: the sack is slang for bed
H is the abbreviation for husband
someone up is lively or excited

explanation.surface: A wife asks whether her husband is having an affair, since he is lively in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To shack up is slang for living with a lover without marrying, which fits moving in with a mistress.

clue.text: Races American out of blocks? Quite the opposite

indicators.text: out of blocks? Quite the opposite
indicators.note: the opposite of coming out of something is going into it, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: to stem a flow is to block it
A is the abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: An American sprinter bursts out of the starting blocks in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: The question reverses the instruction: not out of, but into.
explanation.definitionFit: To steam along is to move fast, so steams means races in the sense of speeds.

clue.text: They throw golf clubs

definitions.meaning: first meaning: athletes who put the shot
second meaning: clubs used on the green

explanation.surface: Frustrated golfers hurl their clubs in a temper.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a golf tantrum; the throwing belongs to the shot put.
explanation.definitionFit: Shot putters hurl a heavy ball, and putters are the flat-faced golf clubs used for rolling the ball into the hole.

clue.text: See Mike with a lead boxing, showing confidence

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: boxing means enclosing, so the lead symbol holds the other pieces

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
lo is an old word for look or see
M is Mike in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A boxer named Mike leads with a confident punch.
explanation.definitionFit: Aplomb is self-assurance and poise, the calm confidence shown under pressure.

clue.text: After judge catches Republican lying

indicators.note: catches means holding something inside, so the Republican letter goes within the word for after

parts.note: post is Latin for after, as in postwar
R is the abbreviation for Republican
to rate something is to judge or assess it

explanation.surface: A judge catches a Republican politician telling lies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lying' looks like telling untruths; it is lying flat on the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Prostrate means lying stretched out face down, as in prostrate on the floor.

clue.text: Bottom of skirt reaching far up top of leg

indicators.note: in a down clue the bottom of a word is its final letter

parts.note: the final letter of skirt
something reaching far up is high

explanation.surface: A miniskirt with a hem that rides right up the leg.
explanation.definitionFit: The thigh is the upper part of the leg between hip and knee.

clue.text: Spanish come again? On vacation start adventure

parts.note: ¿qué? is Spanish for what?, the question meaning pardon

indicators.note: on vacation means emptied, so only the outer letters of the next word remain

parts.note: the outside letters of start

explanation.surface: A Spaniard asks you to repeat yourself as a holiday adventure begins.
explanation.definitionFit: A quest is a long search or journey, which is an adventure in the storybook sense.

clue.text: Ulcerative colitis cases, possible cause?

indicators.note: cases means the words act as a wrapping around the letters wanted

parts.note: the letters run across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: A medical question about what triggers an inflammatory bowel disease.
explanation.walkthrough: The disease names its own possible culprit, the gut bacterium.
explanation.definitionFit: E. coli is a gut bacterium suspected as a possible trigger of colitis, so it is a candidate cause.

clue.text: Asian and European country without borders

indicators.note: without borders strips away the first and last letters of the country

parts.note: Romania is a country in eastern Europe

explanation.surface: A list of an Asian country and a European one with no frontier controls.
explanation.definitionFit: An Omani comes from Oman on the Arabian Peninsula in western Asia.

clue.text: Issue taking tablet yourself

parts.note: an issue of a magazine is a number
someone taking an ecstasy tablet is on E

explanation.surface: Advice about whether you should take a pill for a medical issue.
explanation.walkthrough: E is crossword slang for an ecstasy tablet, so being on E is taking one.
explanation.definitionFit: Looking after number one is an idiom for putting oneself first, so number one is you yourself.

clue.text: One serves meat that's more tough

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a shopkeeper selling meat
second meaning: comparative of butch, rugged and macho

explanation.surface: A waiter brings out a steak that is chewier than it should be.
explanation.definitionFit: A butcher sells cuts of meat, and butcher is also the comparative of butch, meaning more manly and hard.

clue.text: Releases United fixtures after noon

indicators.note: after places the fixtures word behind the noon letter

parts.note: U is the abbreviation for United in football team names
N stands for noon
ties are football cup fixtures

explanation.surface: A football club announces its afternoon match schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: To untie something is to free it from its bonds, so unties is a verb meaning lets loose.
